name: mycrew-specialists
description: Layer 2/4 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who writes the code with the implement skill, a reviewer who hunts the committed code across bugs/cleanliness/security, a tester who proves it (automated, then manual on the visual surface), a designer, a UI/UX agent with taste who owns the product's UI kit as a source of design truth independent of the app's own frontend code, and a philosopher who takes apart what is brought to it — digging until the real goal is in the open, then handing back a call. Each keeps its own domain data under data/.
